The '''GCC-1000''' was a pocket-sized [[Currency/Legends|currency]] converter manufactured by [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]]. It could handle currency exchanges throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].
